name: pos-build
description: The build function of the product OS: a router a build session starts with, a tiered implementation (the session alone, one or two specialists, or the full team), the specialist agents (database, back end, front end, QA, DevSecOps, AI engineer, UX), the access-policy check, the post-implementation checklist with its risk card, the Build pivot with the multi-tenant SaaS, AI engineering and test rules, and a guard against heavy SQL on the production database.
